sourceRefs.locator: 31.4.9–13; 31.5.1–9: forced exchange for food, Greuthungian crossing, banquet and violence at Marcianopolis
31.12.1–13.19: march outside Hadrianopolis on the fifth day before the Ides of August, allied forces, defeat and conflicting accounts of Valens’s death

summary.de: Terwingischer Anführer. Ammianus nennt ihn beim Gastmahl in Marcianopolis und im Zusammenhang mit den Verhandlungen und Kämpfen bei Hadrianopolis.
summary.en: Tervingian leader. Ammianus names him at the banquet in Marcianopolis and in connection with the negotiations and fighting around Hadrianopolis.
